== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Goldmarks serve as a high-value currency used for significant financial transactions and major investments. Within the economic hierarchy, they represent a much larger denomination than standard marks or [[silvermarks]]; for instance, ten thousand goldmarks is equivalent to one million marks. They are frequently utilized for monumental costs, such as the hiring of a [[Navigator]] to cross the [[Aion]] or for purchasing expensive artwork and high-end real estate. Goldmarks can appear as physical coins bearing various guild crests or as printed paper bills. While they are a standard medium for large-[[scale]] commerce and guild-related dealings, their perceived value can vary by culture, with some groups treating gold as if it were common refuse.}}
